dropoffRisk.rationale: Every step told me what would happen before I tapped, nothing was posted publicly without warning, and 'Can't make it?' plus report/block made me feel safe; I'd come back to find more small plans.
Filters were fast and the listing felt legit, but no civil roles and no pay/deadline info means I'd still have to go elsewhere; prep groups might bring me back.
Came with one concrete need (SFO ride); nav, meetup form and search gave no sign rides exist, and Explore is grad seminars — nothing tells a transfer commuter this app is for him
Filters with plain words worked once I figured them out, but the 'No results' scare from my search word and no pay info anywhere make me think I'd just go back to Handshake.
